_help: Concerts and live performances (past shows with videos). Fields: id (unique), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), year (optional), venue, city, country, description, image (optional photo URL), imageAlt, photos (optional list of {src, alt}), playlistUrl (optional YouTube playlist), videos (list of {videoId, title}; an empty title shows the YouTube title collected by the daily sync), source. Upcoming shows go in events.json instead.
